stem: A is a given point. Many circles, each with radius ${=r}$ cm, are drawn through A. Their centers all lie on one circle whose center is A. What is the radius of that circle, in cm?
solution: Each center is at distance ${=r}$ cm from A, because A lies on a circle of radius ${=r}$ cm.
So the centers lie on a circle with center A and the same radius.
notes: Basic: equal radii give centers on a congruent circle centered at A.
